data: Excellent game, very well detailed and great story, great to play with friends
Amazing game, ton's of fun with friends and well worth the price
Amazing game, fun gameplay, great story and characters, very good style, i need more
The grind is well worth it, the story is great, the game play is amazing and playing with friends or your partner is a must
10/10 would buy and thank you to the devs

So i was pumping iron the other day...!!

For how small this game is, there is genuinely so much to do and explore. its very SCP-esque whilst also being its own thing, and that honestly combines all the things i'd want for that interest.
This has become of my favourite survival horror games in a while. its absolutely 100% worth the full price so the discount is an absolute steal imo. Also, the decorating when i get to base is my favourite, so finding new furniture makes me an insane inventory hoarder. 10/10 would recommend ♥

- Lovingly written by a big fan of the coworker

This game is like if you took Half life 1 and turned into a survival crafting game. Unlike most crafting survival games, this one has story/level progression. As you delve deeper into the facility to escape, you unlock new resources, new recipes, and shortcuts back to the hub.

after 152 hours i still recommend this game it has been such a blast to go through and i cant say that I didn't have fun its been a wild ride and after finally beating the game i really can say i want more i hope that we do get content past this i would even willingly pay for more content its just been such a fun time i really don't think a game has kept me this interested for as long as Abiotic Factor has I look forward to whatever Deep Field do next.
Quite a fun game, with looting and bases. Gameplay is interesting, and every area brings something new to the table. It's a well fleshed out game, even for early access.
A completely crazy Half Life-esque parody survival game. It might need a bit a tweaking and polishing here and there but it's a must have for scientists!
This game is so much fun. I've played 31 hours so far and feel like I haven't even scratched the surface. I really wonder how much more there is to even find but I guess I'll find out!
Atmosphere akin to Half Life, a bunch of well fleshed out systems and fun gameplay loops. Combat is fun and the right level of challenging and story is well done if you're big into that.

This game is simply a gem, it's fantastic and just oozes passion and creativity. Everything from the unique setting, delightfully fun weapon designs and stunning inter-dimensional worlds just cements this game as an absolute must play for any fan of the survival craft genre.

Best played with friends but still a fantastic solo game. At the asking price it's more than worth every penny. I 100% recommend this game and have fully enjoyed being there for the early access. I look forwards to seeing how this game continues to grow going forwards now that it has left early access.

quite literally the best survival game I've ever played

upwards of 60+ hours of content, a world and map that keeps on giving, some of the most memorable dialogue, incredible world building, innovative crafting and progression system, one of the most ENGAGING and intriguing stories ever implemented into a survival game, and done seamlessly.

this is truly, the best example of a well crafted, well loved survival game. bravo to the devs for their incredible work and unending commitment to such a masterpiece.

for context, i have hundreds of hours on another platform, but i firmly believe in supporting these developers as much as i can after playing this game, i cannot wait for the DLC.

This is one of the best survival craft games I have ever played.
Play solo, play with friends.

Probably my number one game at the moment... and maybe of all time? I truly LOVE it. I usually never play games solo, and never more than once on my own, but this has been the first game where I did both. Also the first game where I actively tried to 100% all achievements and went out of my way to craft all of the steam badges lol. So... that's definitely saying something!

I just love so many things about it. The crafting, exploring, expansion, base building, cooking, gardening, EVERYTHING! It was just constant awe whenever we unlocked new areas or recipes, and the excitement never seemed to die throughout my playthroughs.

I HIGHLY recommend Abiotic Factor if you like survival games with huge maps, SCP-like lore finding, or good co-ops to goof around with your friends on.
I will for sure be following the roadmap and actively anticipating all future updates, I truly believe Deep Field hit it out of the ballpark with this one. I'm nominating this game for as many categories as I can for the Steam Awards!! I truly believe it deserves to win any of them!

10000000/10

Great game with great aesthetics, humor, and gameplay. Too bad it's made with UE5 because now it runs like shit even though it looks like old graphics. So unnecessary. That reminds me of lethal company doing the same with High Definition Render Pipeline for Unity. The UI could also use a rework.
But that's the only negatives I have on this game so that's good.

Imagine if SCP actually made a survival game but like added some halflife for good measure
I sure as heck enjoyed this and loved all the homage they paid to other games this is science fiction survival done very well

Do you enjoy Half-Life 1's aesthetic and linear progression? Do you enjoy survival games like 7 Days to Die? Congratulations, you just found your new favorite game.

Abiotic Factor takes the survival formula, polishes it a little, and sprinkles some horror elements and references onto it. Problems I had with certain survival games were solved in a clever manner here, and the game is not afraid to keep you on your toes - there'll ALWAYS be something new that you're gonna die to. Sometimes this works to its detriment (looking at you, Ikea and Order village ), but I've been having far more fun with this game than not, and I always look forward to exploring the next area together with my friend.

You should buy it! Maybe you'll get rid of the feeling that someone's watching you.
10/10, came in with no expectations and the game wow'd me. Just get an inventory mod if you are playing solo as the default is crazy low.
Incredible amount of content for an indie game. I have however many hours at the time of this review and I still know there's a lot of stuff left to find on my next playthrough.

Dont let the graphics steer you away from playing this gem.

I have over 167 hours at this point, and playing it yet again. 

I really hope they make a 2nd.

This is a survival crafting game, so if that's not your thing I say this.... Give it a shot anyways.
One of the most fun games I've played with friends in a very long time. Round up the fellas and prepare for one of them to troll the session.

Solid survival crafting, exploration and grinding. The only negative thing right now is the ending making the whole thing pointless.
There is no reason this game runs so bad with graphics like this. Regular crashes.
love the game but it should have a husbandry as well adds more to the stay at base players that just want to farm and raise creatures
I Love Abiotic Factor's blend of analog horror with Half-Life's graphical sylization. This is so much more than another survival crafter with a pooping mechanic.
A survival crafting game with an objective. Runs decent with the steam deck and low spec laptop. Fun game overall would recommend alone or with friends.

Imagine if you've been able to step into the shoes of scientists in Half-Life 1. Literally what this game is all about.
But heck is it addicting. And most importantly, fun!
You will experience a lot of " what is this " and also the need to look behind you a few times just out of " is something there? " feeling :D

My group lost our private server due to a Steam Cloud sync issue and one of the devs went out of his way and made us a brand new server. He gave us supplies, unlocked doors, and saved us hours and hours of backtracking and replaying. This is amazing and unbelievable. I give them my vote for Game of the Year at the Game Awards

I never played any Half Life game so I'm not really fond of the aesthetic of Abiotic Factor. I played with a friend who loved the green couches for nostalgia reasons and I told him straight up they are ugly. They are so ugly that I "accidentally" salvaged them and had to scour the whole map for a new set of green couches to appease him. That being said, Abiotic is AWESOME. It explores a different perspective from the tree-chopping open world survival games out there. The map is carefully designed and I can't praise the devs enough for adding QoL base features. I am really sad I finished the game twice so soon.
Finished the main story in 70 hours, with lots more content to come. You could easily get 100 hours from exploring all the portals and stocking up ready for the next update.

This is the best survival crafting game I've played in years.

My only gripes are the sometimes excessive (and timegated) resource farming, and performance issues (thanks UE5).

Everything else is perfect.

JANET! this is a 11/10 survival game

crafting, exploration, combat and base building, science team certified.

some horror if you're playing singleplayer. (in the best way possible)

just buy it dude, takes a bit to get into the game but it's so worth it.

An enjoyable experience with an intriguing story. With inspiration taken from SCP and Half-Life, Abiotic Factor adds to the open world survival craft genre with an office/research laboratory take on the genre. Interesting lore tidbits here and there keep you craving more as you explore through each sector of the facility, each sector building onto the last with more advanced blueprints, materials, and enemies. While I do have my gripes with the singleplayer endgame balance, it was still enjoyable despite my many skill-issued deaths. Definitely a lot of fun with friends if you like long playtime story games (and it's a lot less grindy with others, too).

Played this with my best friend and I'm glad I did. This is not your normal survival game, and it has way more of a direction, storyline, and sense of purpose than any other survival game I've played. Valheim gets kinda close, but it still has that sense of aimlessness that abiotic doesnt have. The fact I dont have to grind for materials CONSTANTLY for anything other than ammo, which can even be improvised around depending on circumstances. This piece right here is why I took the time to write this review. I really hope the Devs take note and any future devs looking for inspiration take note of this as well. This is a huge piece of the burnout that I see a LOT of people have when playing these games that makes the difference between someone seeing the end of your game versus not.

I think this reminds me more of the gameplay loop (combat / materials wise) to Horizon Zero Dawn but the devs for Abiotic factor have taken it in a manner of which that condenses it and makes it linear enough to enjoy for a long period of time.

Normally, I just fly through games like this and skip a lot of stuff, but this is the first survival-style game I've played (other than palworld) that got me going for more than 40-50 hours.

The best survival crafting game that has come out in years.
A scientist stuck underground, fighting your way out by being a massive nerd. the best.

I'm just about BOILING up

my one critique is that it could perform better graphically. Fantastic game, but a bit on the expensive side when it comes to minimum requirements.

Phenomenal, reminds me of Grounded. But instead of being shrunk down, you're a scientist in a research lab that experienced a breach. A really enjoyable survival game, it's not too challenging but I am playing on normal mode. Also love the art style, the low poly look of like a PS1 game. 9/10
Great Game with great Constuction elements and best of all, you can play with friends.

Great new take on a survival game: 
- Good base building
- Very interesting setting
- Engaging exploration
- Enough "puzzle" style things to keep you on your toes
- High effort in all things, they did a good job
- Eerie and occasionally a bit scary
- Pretty good sense of humor
A very fun and well thought out game, it does get grindy and a little bit boring toward the end.

If you're a fan of Half-Life, Opposing Force, Blue Shift or Decay then you will absolutely love this game. It feels like a love letter to all those games and the survival genre. Fun solo but even better with friends. Great mix of story and survival elements and has a wicked sense of humor to the game that is refreshing to see. It comes with a lot of custom options to tweak the game to your liking that can make it a walk in the park or a true survival experience. All the gear, weapons, tools and furniture you craft will be a mishmash of common office supplies that are an absolute joy to use.

I can't recommend this game enough, especially if you have some friends to experience it with.

Edit: Now that I've completed the game, including the more recent content, and am in the midst of my second full playthrough I can say that this is easily my game of the year. The amount of love put into the development of this game is honestly astonishing and the devs still have loads of content planned for the post 1.0 release.

This game has connected with me in a way that no other game has in years. Indie gaming is not only alive and well but better than ever with developers like this around.

If you don't think you'd like this game because it's not procedural generated:
THINK AGAIN.
I was skeptical about it as I'm a huge fan of Minecraft, Valheim, and No Man's Sky. Honestly, the hand-crafted map design is incredible and I think I actually prefer it more. This game is extremely fun and the game play is super addicting. It's totally playable solo also. Personally: The trailers on steam are fine but I feel like they don't do the game justice. There's so much incredible atmosphere and level design that they don't show (not sure how they would to be fair). If you enjoy crafting/ survival games GIVE THIS GAME A SHOT.
The game is great. Always something to improve upon. Grab a friend and save the world!

Find a scary blind man

Profit

Find toilet but lose out on skill gains? or poop-pants

10/10 game

Truly one of the coolest survival games to come out in recent years. The story is SCP + Half Life, there's so much content. It it still fairly cozy to play, but you will hit some parts that make you sit up straight and lock in.

The devs have listened and added so much during early access and just continue to put out patch after patch of great content. If you like any sort of survival games, or just the vibe of Half-Life and SCP, do yourself a favor and buy the game. It's even worth full price if there's no sale, you won't regret it.

And if you don't like some of the schticks for the survival mode? There's fully customizable options that won't lock you out of any achievements or content. I hate food spoilage in games, turned it off completely. Grinding feels a little slow? 2x XP. Feel like you run out of materials? Turn on the item respawn, it'll be back to collect again. Item stacks too small? Bump it up. Just don't pickup 5 times a full stack of highly irradiated items, trust me.
Hidden gem, incredible level design for survival game, interesting and spooky setting also. Exlporation is so good, it hurts (to hoard all the stuff).

I'm writing this review 171 hours into the game...

The best advice I read before deciding to buy this game was to be patient with it. It starts out slow but then grows the further you get in.

Crafting is accessible and not bogged down in complexity. You'll die multiple times, but that's OK you just respawn with a bit of equipment damage to repair.

The voice acting early in the game seems really slow, but gets more natural the furher in you go.

Worth the money.

Bloody Awesome survival game. Not as popular as I thought it would be. Online is dead, but that can be easily adjusted. Story is good, game play is good. The new sectors are brilliant and it has a lot to offer. If you like survival games, give this one a chance. it is worth the price tag

No idea what I was walking into. Thought it was a simple stab things and get out. This game is amazing, detailed, and endlessly playable. You are rewarded of being snoopy, and for wanting to find things. Secrets and puzzles, and stalkers. I can see myself coming back to this game again and again. Can't wait for new content. A++

simply the best survival game there is, if you enjoy the setting. map design is peak (darksouls 1 vibes), items are fun, crafting and base management is not getting harder, because you unlock new qol things by progressing through the story. the story is hillarious, if you like half life - just buy this.

looks good and runs smooth on deck after minmaxing the settings.

The game was amazingly large. Enemy progression felt good, and exploration was awesome. Quirky humor with the characters and the situations they were in. Just fantastically made; the devs should feel proud of their creation.

I don't often write reviews, but I feel compelled to this time. The best way to describe it, I'd say... Is, take Half Life 1, but you're not Gordon Freeman. You're one of those random scientists that die left and right. It's become my favourite survival game - It's quirky and humorous enough, without underselling its setting and serious elements. If you're not a fan of survival games, this is one. If you like them, this is a pretty cool one that tries cool things. It's... Half Life 1 meets SCP, I guess. With all the weird entities and duct taped gadgets that entails.

amazing survival game. It feels a touch generic at first but QUICKLY opens up to a deeply interesting and fun game. There is little I'd say needs fixing, maybe some optimisation? Some balance pases? But at its core, this is a clear, novel vision, executed with clear passion.

Pretty cool little survival game set in a Half Life-esque world. Not a bunch in the way of base building. First two zones are extremely well done. Starts to drop off a little bit after with not much in the way up upgrades and a dip in level design. Still very enjoyable and seems like the updates are coming along nicely.

tldr.text: Overwhelmingly Positive (96%): players praise the story and characters, and the co-op with friends.
Combat and the grind are the usual complaints, though recent reviews mention them less.

details.text: Early reviewers, who had played only a couple of hours, are far less positive (74%) than long-time players (98%).
Recent reviews complain far less about the grind than before, though one says newer lore "does not fit with the overall theme".
